description: This file implements the Credentials class in the AWS SDK for PHP, providing methods for handling AWS credentials such as access key, secret key, token, expiration, and related functionalities.

classes.name: Credentials
classes.description: Provides a basic implementation of AWS credentials, allowing initialization with access key, secret key, token, and expiration details. Supports serialization and expiration extension.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing AWS credentials with key, secret, token, expiration, account ID, and source.

methods.name: __set_state
methods.description: Creates a Credentials instance from a exported state array.

methods.name: getAccessKeyId
methods.description: Returns the AWS access key ID.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the credentials are expired based on current time.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Returns the account ID associated with the credentials.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source of the credentials.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Represents the credentials as an array.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Restores the credentials object from a serialized JSON string.

methods.name: __serialize
methods.description: Prepares the credentials data for serialization.

methods.name: __unserialize
methods.description: Restores the credentials object from the unserialized data array.

methods.name: extendExpiration
methods.description: Extends the credentials expiration time and triggers a warning message.
